tcs.tc_title: Right-hand drive mirrors the heated steering wheel icon to the right
tcs.test_item:
If $DriverSide$ = [Right Side], the HU shall mirror the location of the Heated Steering Wheel Icon, showing it in the right side of the Heated / Vented Seats screen.

(Right-hand drive icon placement)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a heated steering wheel
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 0 (Left Side)
3. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the position of the heated steering wheel icon on the Heated / Vented Seats screen and record as HSW_icon_position_initial
2. Set PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
3. Power cycle the HU so that the configuration is applied
4. Open the Heated / Vented Seats screen and check that the heated steering wheel icon is on the opposite side from HSW_icon_position_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. HSW_icon_position_initial is recorded
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side) is accepted
3. The HU completes start-up
4. The heated steering wheel icon is shown on the right side of the Heated / Vented Seats screen, mirrored from HSW_icon_position_initial

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之觸發為 PROXI Driver_Side 之配置，驗證對象為加熱方向盤圖示之左右位置；其餘九列皆非圖示位置。

tcs.tc_title: Left front heated seat shows off after wake-up until status arrives
tcs.test_item:
When the HU wakes up on the BH-CAN bus, the HU shall show the Front Left Heated Seat as off until it receives a status update on CAN.

(Wake-up before first status)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with heated front seats
2. The HU is in a sleep state on the BH-CAN bus
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Wake the HU on the BH-CAN bus without sending any STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts frame
2. Open the Heated / Vented Seats screen and check that the left front heated seat is shown as off
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes wake-up on the BH-CAN bus
2. The left front heated seat is shown as off

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗左前座椅於喚醒後、首次狀態更新前顯示為 off；-022 驗右前座椅於喚醒時狀態被設為 OFF。

tcs.tc_title: Left front heated seat display follows a changed valid status
tcs.test_item:
When the HU receives a $HeatedSeatFL$ signal, it shall compare to the stored state and, if different, and valid, replace the stored value with the new value and change the display to the new state.

(Valid status change)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with heated front seats
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 0 (Heated_seat_off)
2. Read the displayed state of the left front heated seat and record as HS_FL_display_initial
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 3 (Heated_seat_high) and check that the displayed state of the left front heated seat changes from HS_FL_display_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 0 (Heated_seat_off) is sent
2. HS_FL_display_initial is recorded as off
3. The left front heated seat is displayed as high

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列送有效值 3 (Heated_seat_high) 且期望顯示變更；-008 送無效值 2 (Heated_seat_medium) 且期望顯示不變。

tcs.tc_title: Left front heated seat ignores an invalid status value
tcs.test_item:
The HU shall ignore invalid $HeatedSeatFL$ signals, if received.

(Two-state vehicle, medium is invalid)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is configured for the two-stage seat setting (LO and HI), whose valid states are Off, Low and High
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 1 (Heated_seat_low)
2. Read the displayed state of the left front heated seat and record as HS_FL_display_initial
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 2 (Heated_seat_medium) and check that the displayed state of the left front heated seat is unchanged from HS_FL_display_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 1 (Heated_seat_low) is sent
2. HS_FL_display_initial is recorded as low
3. The left front heated seat is still displayed as low, unchanged from HS_FL_display_initial

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列送無效值 2 (Heated_seat_medium) 且期望顯示不變；-007 送有效值 3 (Heated_seat_high) 且期望顯示變更。

tcs.tc_title: Left front heated seat switch greyed out outside ignition run
tcs.test_item:
If $PowerMode$ <> [Ignition run], the left front heated seat switch, shall be shown as greyed-out, with a status of OFF.

(PowerMode other than ignition run)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with heated front seats
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Read the state of the left front heated seat switch and check that it is selectable
3. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK) and check that the left front heated seat switch is greyed out with a status of OFF
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) is sent
2. The left front heated seat switch reads selectable
3. The left front heated seat switch is greyed out and shows a status of OFF

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之驗證對象為左前加熱座椅開關之灰階；-029 之驗證對象為右前加熱座椅開關。

tcs.tc_title: Left front heated seat request returns to not pressed
tcs.test_item:
The HU shall follow this signal with an on change $FL_HS_RQ$ = [Not Pressed / HS_NOT_PSD] within a time period of <Tsend>.

(Release after a press)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with heated front seats
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. BH-CAN is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the signal TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm and check that it is 0 (Not_Pressed)
2. Press the left front heated seat switch on the Heated / Vented Seats screen
3. Read the signal TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm and check that it has returned to 0 (Not_Pressed)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The signal TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm reads 0 (Not_Pressed)
2. TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm = 1 (Pressed) is sent
3. The signal TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm reads 0 (Not_Pressed) after the press

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗按下後請求訊號於 <Tsend> 內回到 0 (Not_Pressed)；其餘各列皆非請求訊號之時序。

tcs.remarks: BLOCKED: DR-24′ —— 來源之時限 `<Tsend>` 無具體值，時限之驗證不寫入 expected_result（42 包 §3.2、canon §8.7.1）

tcs.tc_title: Right front heated seat state set to off at wake-up
tcs.test_item:
When the HU wakes up on the BH-CAN bus, the HU shall set the RF heated seat state to OFF.

(Wake-up initial state)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with heated front seats
2. The HU is in a sleep state on the BH-CAN bus
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FR_HS_STATSts = 3 (Heated_seat_high) and put the HU into a sleep state on the BH-CAN bus
2. Wake the HU on the BH-CAN bus, open the Heated / Vented Seats screen and check that the right front heated seat state is OFF
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU enters a sleep state on the BH-CAN bus
2. The right front heated seat state is OFF

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗右前座椅於喚醒時狀態被設為 OFF；-003 驗左前座椅於喚醒後、首次狀態更新前顯示為 off。

reasoning: 本批自穩定核心（generatable = yes ∧ quoted_form_risk = no）之 72 條中扣已用 12、可選 59，依 reqid 升冪取 10。驗證目標為加熱座椅之喚醒初始狀態、有效狀態更新、無效值忽略、電源模式下之灰階、請求訊號之釋放時序，以及右駕配置下加熱方向盤圖示之鏡射。關鍵情境條件以 CAN-B 之 $STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts$／$FR_HS_STATSts$、$STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts$、BH-CAN 之 $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm$ 與 PROXI Driver_Side 驅動，值一律取 DBC VAL_ 逐字。切分依 §4.6 之 sibling 比對，四對左右鏡像逐對比對後無 duplicate_of，十列全數輸出 distinguishing_axis。值域演繹：$PowerMode$ 之 [Ignition run] 依跨條文錨點 [4h:Ignition run]（全文 5 處）解為 4 (RUN)，非 R-VS43 之演繹而是來源自載原始碼值；$FL_HS_RQ$ 之 [Not Pressed / HS_NOT_PSD] 依錨點 0h: not pressed 解為 0 (Not_Pressed)。無效值之依據為 4858307 逐字「For vehicles with two states (i.e. LO and HI) … Valid values … HS_OFF, HS_LO, HS_HI」，故 2 (Heated_seat_medium) 於二階配置下為無效，非本層造值；三階配置之分支由 4858308 擁有（§8.2.1）。
